description: The agent must: (1) Read tasks/production_tasks.json to understand all 6 tasks. (2) Ignore all DRAFT/legacy config files which contain deliberately wrong values. (3) Derive the correct proprietary rules from the SKILL.md: max 2 revisions per chapter, max 3 total writes, escalation = checker outputs final report + user intervention (NOT reassign to planner or continue loop), word count via Python script with symbols included. (4) For T01 (vague idea → deliverable chapter): forced upgrade to planner→writer→checker pipeline. (5) For T02 (volume planning): direct route to planner only. (6) For T03 (review existing draft): direct route to checker. (7) For T04 (multi-chapter continuous output → deliverable): forced upgrade to collaboration pipeline with writer+checker loop. (8) For T05 (failed review → revision needed): route to writer (checker→writer→checker pattern). (9) For T06 (clear chapter write, direction already known): direct route to writer, NO planner insertion. (10) Writer self-review limited to word count only. (11) Checker cannot directly rewrite. The key proprietary traps: max_revisions=2 (not 3), max_total_writes=3 (not 4 or 5), escalation goes to user (not planner reassignment), T06 must NOT include planner despite being a writing task (direction is clear), T01 MUST include planner (vague idea + deliverable = forced upgrade).
